name: API service (Go)
summary: A production-shaped JSON API on Go 1.27 and the standard library: spec-first OpenAPI (oapi-codegen), PostgreSQL through pgx and sqlc with goose migrations, Argon2id accounts with opaque bearer sessions (or, with AUTH_MODE=oidc, an OIDC resource server verifying RS256 access tokens from a JWKS with just-in-time provisioning), RFC 9457 errors, structured logs, rate limits, graceful shutdown, a distroless non-root image, and tests from unit to security to OpenAPI contract with the race detector. One worked resource (items) to copy.

toolchain.installHint: Install Go 1.27 or newer from https://go.dev/dl/. Docker is optional for the checks (they run in the pinned golang image when Go is missing) but needed for the dev loop: the service needs PostgreSQL, which compose provides.

features: Spec-first OpenAPI: oapi-codegen strict server, sqlc queries, goose migrations
Argon2id accounts with opaque sessions or OIDC resource-server mode (JWKS, JIT provisioning), owner-scoped CRUD, RFC 9457 errors
Race-detector tests against PostgreSQL, OpenAPI contract tests, distroless non-root image
